# 📡 API Change Checklist

- [ ] Method, path, and HTTP status documented.
- [ ] Request DTO and validation documented.
- [ ] Response DTO allow-lists required fields only.
- [ ] Authentication requirements documented.
- [ ] Role and resource ownership checks implemented.
- [ ] Error response behavior documented.
- [ ] Pagination and limits considered.
- [ ] Idempotency and retry behavior considered.
- [ ] Sensitive data and logging reviewed.
- [ ] Unit, MVC, and security tests added.
- [ ] OpenAPI contract updated.
- [ ] Backward compatibility and deprecation considered.
- [ ] Example requests use fake, non-sensitive values.
